A business administration graduate, he developed residential projects ranging from villas to city apartments. His company also entered mixed-use developments and sold the office element of its Paseo Carré scheme to an institutional property investor.

long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Stefan Mayr first encountered building sites alongside his father Georg, an architect with a family construction business. His own early projects involved restoring older Munich properties, including a neoclassical villa where M-Concept added an underground garage. At Gärtnerplatz, M-Concept reinstated a roof storey lost during the war while renovating the rest of the historic building.

M-Concept's sponsorship of a charity brunch at Feinkost Käfer allowed the event's entire proceeds to go to Kinderhilfe Salberghaus. Mayr and Eva supported the fundraiser to help create a therapeutic music room for children in the institution's care.

uncertainties: Research as of 1 October 2026. Property developer identity is a bounded inference, not a verified title chain for Almax Too or Future. The exact-name physicist also born in 1973 is excluded through corporate, geographic and professional convergence; no academic facts imported.

Exact January birthday is withheld because it relies on a derivative corporate record and lacks adequate independent corroboration. Secondary nationality, current main residence and birthplace remain unresolved. Business addresses are not treated as residence.

The material ownership evidence is historical managing-partner status plus a personal general-partner interest; individual percentages are not projected across all group entities. Present leadership supports continuity, with economic-value uncertainty preserved.

Mcon Holding HRA 92046 is distinct from M-Concept Real Estate HRA 106639 and the named project company under preliminary administration. Holding accounting deficits are not proof of personal insolvency, whole-group insolvency or the elimination of every beneficial asset.

Founder is preferred to Unknown after direct and inference checks: this is the personally created principal commercial platform with positive continuing management evidence. Impairment affects confidence without erasing that relationship. Operator is less descriptive of the expressly created core; passive ownership is unsupported.

The current industry uses an explicit origin-sector fallback. No complete private allocation or ownership schedule has been verified. Gross corporate assets, institutional investor funds and prospective projects are not personal wealth.
Founding-year sources differ between 1999 and 2000; both biographies omit the year. No supported family-business conveyance or material launch financing is established.

Only the strongly corroborated professional profile and official company site are proposed; academic and name-only social matches were rejected.
